raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Since the 2026-01-16 rollout, collector 'v2' writes txn_ts in UTC while 'legacy' writes America/Chicago local time. v2 rows are therefore shifted +6h: 12:00 UTC is 06:00 local, and late-evening 01-18 sales land on 01-19 at 00:00-04:10. Converting v2 timestamps to Chicago time (UTC-6; no DST in January) fixes the hours and the dates.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.9,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
